properties.displayName: QC - User account enabled and password not reset for 48 hours
properties.description: This analytics checks for password resets that take effect after 48 hours since the account has been enabled.
properties.query:
let starttime = 3d;
let SecEvents = materialize (xw_securityevent
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(starttime)
    | where EventID in (4722, 4723, 4724)
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | where TargetAccount !startswith_cs ("UK\\uk")
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        EventID,
        Activity,
        Computer,
        TargetAccount,
        TargetSid,
        SubjectAccount,
        SubjectUserSid,
        BusinessUnit = BUID);
let userEnable = SecEvents
    | extend EventID4720Time = TimeGenerated
    // 4722: User Account Enabled
    | where EventID == 4722
    | project
        Time_Event4722 = TimeGenerated,
        TargetAccount,
        TargetSid,
        SubjectAccount_Event4722 = SubjectAccount,
        SubjectUserSid_Event4722 = SubjectUserSid,
        Activity_4722 = Activity,
        Computer_4722 = Computer,
        BusinessUnit;
let userPwdSet = SecEvents
    // 4723: Attempt made by user to set password
    // 4724: An attempt was made to reset an accounts password 
    | where EventID in (4723, 4724)
    | project
        Time_PwSet = TimeGenerated,
        TargetAccount,
        TargetSid,
        SubjectAccount_PwSet = SubjectAccount,
        SubjectUserSid_EventPwSet = SubjectUserSid,
        Activity_PwSet = Activity,
        Computer_PwSet = Computer;
userEnable
| join kind=leftouter userPwdSet on TargetAccount, TargetSid
| extend PasswordSetAttemptDelta_Min = datetime_diff('minute', Time_PwSet, Time_Event4722)
| project-reorder Time_PwSet, Time_Event4722, PasswordSetAttemptDelta_Min
| where PasswordSetAttemptDelta_Min > 2880 //or isempty(PasswordSetAttemptDelta_Min)
| project-away TargetAccount1, TargetSid1
| extend Reason = @"User either has not yet attempted to set the initial password after account was Created or it occurred after 48 hours"
| order by Time_Event4722 asc 
| extend
    timestamp = Time_Event4722,
    AccountCustomEntity = TargetAccount,
    HostCustomEntity = Computer_4722
| project-reorder
    Time_Event4722,
    Time_PwSet,
    PasswordSetAttemptDelta_Min,
    TargetAccount,
    TargetSid,
    BusinessUnit
